title: The copper rain chain
alt: A copper rain chain pours into a dark stone basin in a lush Japanese garden.
description: A rainy architectural detail with continuous cup links, flowing water and textured greenery.
prompt: A precise architectural detail photograph of a Japanese garden in rainfall. A vertical copper rain chain made of connected cup-shaped links descends from a roof gutter into a round dark stone basin. Water visibly flows down through the open cups and splashes into the basin; moss, wet fern fronds, gravel and a timber wall fill the layered scene. Entire chain from gutter outlet to basin is visible, realistic reflections and gravity, sophisticated subdued green and copper colour, no people or text.
